$comment: MCP server definitions in Cursor-compatible format, consumed by llama-server --mcp-servers-config.
$note: llama.cpp's parser is stdio-only (it reads command/cwd/args/env/timeout_ms and skips entries without a command), so HTTP servers are reached through mcp-stdio-bridge.mjs.
$why_only_notecode: llama-server needs only the notecode server here: it publishes the notecode_* schemas in GET /tools for the local chat turn. Every MCP call is dispatched through the app's own client (LlamaServer.Dispatch), and the blender and global-brain tools were never offered to the local model, so starting them here only cost RAM the model needs. REA is on demand and started by /rea only.
